evals.name: plain-resync
evals.prompt: Pull the latest design system tokens into the theme and make sure everything is still in order.
evals.expected_output: Runs npm run tokens:sync (which builds the design system, validates the contract, and copies dist/tokens.flat.css to assets/design-tokens.css verbatim), and reports a clean sync without hand-editing any generated file.
assertions: assets/design-tokens.css is byte-identical to ../design-system/dist/tokens.flat.css (synced verbatim, no hand edits)
scripts/design-tokens-contract.mjs left unchanged
snippets/design-system-bridge.liquid left unchanged
blocks/mionas-text.liquid left unchanged
shopify theme check passes in the theme

evals.name: upstream-revalue-heading
evals.prompt: We bumped the heading text role's font size to 24px in the design system. Update the theme so it picks that up.
evals.expected_output: Runs the sync, sees the contract fail with a wrong-value error (expected 22px, got 24px), updates the expected value in scripts/design-tokens-contract.mjs to 24px, re-syncs so assets/design-tokens.css carries the 24px literal, and runs shopify theme check clean. Does not hand-edit design-tokens.css and does not revert the design system.
assertions: assets/design-tokens.css is byte-identical to ../design-system/dist/tokens.flat.css (synced verbatim, no hand edits)
contract expects 24px for --text-role-heading-font-size
assets/design-tokens.css declares --text-role-heading-font-size: 24px as a literal
design system source still says 24px (source of truth was not reverted)
shopify theme check passes in the theme

evals.name: upstream-rename-hero
evals.prompt: The design system renamed the `hero` text role to `display`. Sync the theme with that change.
evals.expected_output: Updates the four hero entries in scripts/design-tokens-contract.mjs to the display names, re-points the h1 mapping in snippets/design-system-bridge.liquid at --text-role-display-*, greps the whole theme for stale var(--text-role-hero-*) references and updates blocks/mionas-text.liquid too, re-syncs successfully, and runs shopify theme check clean. The block update is the discriminating step: the contract alone does not guard block-spent tokens.
assertions: assets/design-tokens.css is byte-identical to ../design-system/dist/tokens.flat.css (synced verbatim, no hand edits)
contract lists the four --text-role-display-* tokens and no --text-role-hero-*
bridge maps h1 to --text-role-display-* with no stale hero references
blocks/mionas-text.liquid updated to --text-role-display-* with no stale --text-role-hero-* (a stale var() is silent)
shopify theme check passes in the theme

evals.name: drift-review-icon-button
evals.prompt: Sync the theme with the design system.
evals.expected_output: Runs the token sync, then the drift review over the design-system commits since the last sync. Finds that IconButton now composes Button with its eight variants and three sizes, and lists the drift: snippets/mionas-icon-button.liquid carries theme-only outline/outline-inverse variants and a single size, and the newsletter popup close and widget close buttons are lookalikes restating the look in local CSS. Reports one table with each element, its target design-system variant and size, and the visible effect, then waits for approval before changing pages.
assertions: assets/design-tokens.css is byte-identical to ../design-system/dist/tokens.flat.css (synced verbatim, no hand edits)
the report names snippets/mionas-popup.liquid's close button and snippets/mionas-popup-widget.liquid's close button as lookalikes of IconButton
the report maps the theme-only outline/outline-inverse icon-button variants to design-system Button variants
the report lists the stored icon-button and social-link instances in templates/page.contacto.json and sections/footer-group.json
no block, snippet, section or template changed before the user approved the proposal
